user: I have a strong dislike for any shows or movies that feature laugh tracks or canned audience laughter.
assistant:  I understand. It can be distracting and feel artificial when laughter is added in post-production. Some people find that it takes away from the authenticity of the humor and can even be annoying. If you prefer media that doesn't use laugh tracks, you might enjoy watching shows and movies that are more dialogue-driven, or ones that rely on visual humor or other forms of comedic storytelling. There are many great options out there that don't use laugh tracks, so you have plenty of choices to explore.
